title: One view instead of Basic and Advanced
caption: At Lv 39 the page has no Basic / Advanced switch: the milestone tools sit behind a ⋯ button and the dungeon filters under Filters and notes.

title: A late start at level 39
caption: A player starting at Lv 39 now sees every card's footer, Respec and the skills progress bar, with the extra detail folded.

title: The one view on a phone
caption: On a phone at Lv 39 Next up has its 1 of N pager and Progress starts folded, the same for every player.

title: A fresh start on a phone
caption: A new player at Lv 1 opens the one view: Next up first, Route rules and The map in folds.

title: More you could do, opened
caption: At Lv 1 on a phone, Next up's "More you could do (4)" opens on one line and lists the upcoming skill buys and the Lv 4 milestone.

title: Dungeon filters and notes, opened
caption: At Lv 39, opening Filters and notes brings back the dungeon filters, the reward lines and the per-region counts in place.
